title: Long run 2h40 / ~1000m D+, 2 race-effort climbs
terrain: Mountain or hills: Presolana or Lecco pre-alps first choice, Colli Berici repeats second; ~1000m D+, two climbs of 15min+ and their descents

steps.target: Z2-Z3, 140-160bpm, descent at race effort, 172+ spm

coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 2h40, ~1000m D+. 15min easy, 1h35 at 145-155bpm (hike over 15%). Then 2x(15min climb at 160-168bpm + 10min descent at race effort, 172+ spm).
GYM: none.
FUEL: 2 flasks Tailwind (500ml, 2 scoops) from min 20, Carbo Gels at 1h15 and 2h00 (~75g/h). Full race-day rehearsal: same breakfast, same kit.
GARMIN: ~230-270.
STOP RULE: HRV under 55 or RHR 52+ = 1 race-effort block, cap at 2h15. Knee signal on descents: walk them.
WHY: last big long run is Wk7; this one rehearses VWT's back half, race effort on tired legs, both up and down.
